label: Hybrid Si / III-V three-level taper Type 1, Si 1.0 um at final taper, 24 um mesa, 1550 nm
core_material: SOI 700 nm Si, 400 nm deep trenches (rib), 1 um BOX, vertical outgassing channels; wafer-bonded AlGaInAs / InP III/V stack (8 x 7 nm AlGaInAs QWs, PL 1410 nm, 125 nm SCH layers, 1.5 um p-InP cladding, InGaAsP superlattice, 10 nm InP bonding layer; Table 1); no metallization
notes: Si-to-hybrid mode converter (rule 10: on-chip inter-material transition). three III/V taper levels start within 2.4 um of each other (Fig. 2 labels 1.2 um / 1.2 um); final III/V taper 80 um; Si tapered to 2 um for 100 um before the first III/V tip, then to 1.0 um at the start of the final level (p.3-4). Simulated QW confinement 15.6 % in the hybrid waveguide (p.4, Fig. 4; no parameter). Back reflection not entered: Table 4 (p.10) gives R_t -44.0 dB (one device, no error bar), an upper limit set by the setup noise floor (FT of HR-OSA transmission of polished devices, TE, Fig. 10); back_reflection_db is not allowed on waveguide_platform (registry gap). Loss values are per taper: p.6 calls the Fig. 5(b) result the taper (pair) loss, but the abstract, Sec. 3.3 and Sec. 5 state the Table 2 range 0.22-0.57 dB per taper, and a check of the Fig. 5(b) slopes (about 1.66 dB per section for Type 1 - 1.0 um minus 0.64 dB hybrid loss, about 0.64 dB per section for Type 2 - 1.5 um minus 0.2 dB; audit reading of the fitted lines on a 400 dpi render) gives twice the Table 2 values, so the table is per taper. Table 2 footnotes cite Fig. 6 for what is Fig. 5 (D417). Passive chip with blue-shifted QWs (PL 1410 nm) so the III/V is transparent at 1550 nm (p.2-3). Fab empty: 'A passive chip was fabricated' (passive voice, p.2); authors at UCSB (Kurczveil also HP Labs, Pintus also Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna). Measured with TE light at 1550 nm through 7 deg angled 2 um Si facets with lensed fibers, about 9.5 dB per facet (p.4-5).
